title: Did David Scarpa "Borrow" From Stanley Kubrick?

commenti.body: Maybe. But the film is a bomb. Apparently it enters the Panderverse. Scott paints the lead as a cuck who takes out his rage on the people. How the French view Napoleon is whatever. But turning him into an incel is pandering and lazy writing. There’s no awards buzz about it because of the French response, and people tired of the Panderverse. Scott thought people would eat up Napoleon as a mentally ill incel. Nobody wants it. I don’t want to go see a movie about an incel. Ideas could have been stolen. But the lazy out of date storyline is a huge nope. Men’s mental health is being taken more seriously. An incel film is tired and that fad wore out a few years ago. Im interested to see how Joker 2 will do. Idea theft is a bad offense. But nothing could be more pathetic than an aging director taking history and thinking it’s 5 years ago and that people would still buy a cuck tale that didn’t actually happen.
